SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
UPPER ENDOSCOPIC ULTRASOUND (EUS) REPORT
Facility: Kingsmere University Hospital (fictional)
Patient: Rosalind Achterhof (fictional)
Date of service: November 5, 2026
Endoscopist: Victor Ilunga, MD (fictional)
Indication: Pancreatic head mass on CT; tissue diagnosis requested.
Procedure: As part of this EUS, an EGD was first performed with a standard gastroscope.
The esophagus, stomach and duodenum to the second portion were normal on the EGD portion.
The linear echoendoscope was then advanced to the second portion of the duodenum.
EUS imaging was performed from the esophagus, stomach and duodenum.
EUS findings: a 24 mm hypoechoic mass in the pancreatic head; common bile duct 9 mm.
No lymphadenopathy or liver lesion was seen.
EUS-guided fine-needle aspiration of the pancreatic head mass: 22-gauge needle, 3 passes.
The needle passes were made through the duodenal wall.
Impression: 24 mm pancreatic head mass, sampled by EUS-guided fine-needle aspiration.
Plan: Await cytology; multidisciplinary pancreas review.
